name: ColorPicker
usage: Label and tag colors, brand colors in settings, annotation colors

props.name: value
props.description: Current color as a hex string (controlled), such as `#2d6bf3`, or `#2d6bf380` with transparency.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial color (uncontrolled); any CSS color string.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new color as a lowercase hex string (with alpha when it is not opaque).

props.name: presets
props.description: Groups of preset colors shown below the panel.

props.name: showText
props.description: Shows the value as text next to the swatch.

props.name: disabledAlpha
props.description: Hides the alpha slider: the color is always opaque.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the panel opens or closes.

props.name: aria-label
props.description:
Accessible name of the built-in trigger; the built-in text by default ("Color"). Not used when `children`
provides a custom trigger.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom trigger instead of the swatch, such as a Button.

types.name: ColorPreset
types.summary: A group of preset colors offered by ColorPicker.

fields.name: colors
fields.description: Colors in the group, as CSS color strings such as `#2D6BF3`.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Click the swatch, or focus it with `Tab` and press `Enter`; `showText` shows the value next to it.

examples.name: Presets
examples.title: Presets
examples.description: `presets` offers a set of colors to pick from; `disabledAlpha` hides the alpha slider.
